shore_transition.scope: Full local-lake freeboard outside source-lake buffers; original dry geometry has a separate marine floor when all lakes transition.

plane_bound_method: Whole triangle when all corners pass; exact clipped affine extrema otherwise. Lake/island minima are conservative lower bounds.
limits: Independent ASC geometry only; native import, runtime waves, visual smoothing and navmesh remain unverified.
Lake cores exclude an8.485m shoreline band,4.5m for the23approved small-lake transitions; empty cores use a wet representative.
Map outer two vertex rows remain exact; coast proof excludes outer two cells.
Whole-road smoothness remains a separate open gate.
